name: rigid-contact modality
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 将轮轨几何与蠕滑关系按刚性接触约束组织的建模方式。
usage_note: 作者据此构造整体矩阵并讨论大步长稳定性，不能把结论推广到所有接触算法。

complete_examples.text: By dealing the wheel-rail contact geometries/creepages with rigid-contact modality, this dynamic system can be solved with large time step size with computational stability guaranteed and accordingly, lowering the time consuming.
